hypothesis: The EVAL-52 fused options-surface x options-venue-order-flow NO-GO is temporally stable across an independent synchronized ~24h Deribit capture (window B, BTC+ETH).

protocol.title: Real Deribit options surface x options-venue order flow net-of-cost falsification

fusion_detail.sign_agreement: both options-side legs agree in sign -> take that sign, else flat
fusion_detail.regime_filter: surface sign as causal regime gate x order-flow direction
fusion_detail.continuous_zscore: causal expanding z-score of each leg, summed, clip(z_sum/2,-1,1)

protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: pre-registered 5 bps on turnover (taker + impact)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled PBO < 0.5; else NO-GO.

meta_go_bar: GO CONFIRMED only if the per-config GO bar (net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach max-DD <= 0.20, permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0) holds on both windows for the same config on both BTC and ETH, and pooled PBO < 0.5 on both windows; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS) when both windows floor-passing; BLOCKED if window B is below the heavy-work floor.
